summary_bullets: Add positional filename support to scripts/lint-bash32.sh for pre-commit incremental scans while preserving whole-repo --root/default behavior.
Wire lint-bash32 into .pre-commit-config.yaml with explicit .sh/.inc.bash matching and staged filename passing.
Expand the Bash 3.2 regression harness and linting docs for the new caller and path-resolution behavior.
commit_message:
Add Bash 3.2 pre-commit hook

Wire scripts/lint-bash32.sh into pre-commit with positional filename support for incremental staged-file checks. Keep whole-repo untracked-aware coverage through make lint-bash32 and local make lint, and add positional-mode regression coverage for .sh, .inc.bash, skip, and outside-root cases.
